HUNT Cloud, NTNU | Trondheim, Norway | Full-stack software engineer | ONSITE | https://about.hdc.ntnu.no/en/about/careers

HUNT Cloud provides trustworthy cloud computing for high-impact science that utilizes sensitive data. We believe it should be simple for scientists to get flexible, elegant and secure digital laboratories.

Tech stack:

  * Research services for sensitive data and high impact international science.
  * Multisite on-prem Openstack cloud deployment with +10 petabytes of multilayered Ceph storage and +6000 vCPUs.
  * Tailor-made research tools for interactive computing and data transfers.
  * Flask API services (Python) on the backend.
  * Vue (Javascript and Typescript) on the frontend.
  * Key management using Vault.
  * CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as code (IaC).  
  * Compliance with ISO-standards for quality, security and privacy.
If you're interested in shaping sensitive data infrastructure or if you have any questions feel free to reach out: cloud@hunt.ntnu.no.
